build_contract.blender: Pinned automatic offline converters: 4.3.2 for Melee target reading, 4.5.7 for Colosseum/glTF-Collada conversion, bpy 5.2.2 for fixed character recipes; no interactive authoring

steps.result: Read supported disc files and unpack FSYS archives from explicit user ISO paths.
Generate stock icons and party-face CSS fallback icons directly from Colosseum.
All 29 source models rebuilt directly from Colosseum with the pinned original reader; each complete GLB matches the original authoring input.

steps.source: round_cast.sh, hand_finish.py and per-character hand scripts
steps.result: All 29 costumes rebuilt in an empty directory using the isolated offline runtime and fresh 27-fighter Melee targets. 25 exports, including Smoochum v2, match the historical reference byte for byte; Combusken's arm roll and Machoke's crest color have reviewed recipe corrections. Pikachu and Scyther retain documented small conversion differences.

steps.implementation: pokemelee.stages, pokemelee.phenac, pokemelee.anime_stage, native stage helpers
steps.result: All 22 stage files rebuilt from the two source discs in empty directories; SHA-256 matches both desktop reference builds. Windows native path verified.
All base and alternate portraits, 54 CSS icons and both sets of six stage pictures regenerated. Both assembled CSS/SSS menus compared with the accepted desktop ISOs.

All 104 alternate costumes and 133 packages per variant rebuilt. Paired/team costume slots installed and exercised in game. Every fighter's slot k carries vanilla colour k's joint rest values bit for bit (recipes/rest-values.json; past vanilla's colours, colour 0's), the model kept in its rest pose, so a vanilla opponent simulates it as this disc does. Captain Falcon has vanilla's six slots and team indices (red 2, green 4, blue 5) for Slippi's Teams mode.

Both complete projects exported and booted. Paired fighters, alternate costumes and contact attacks checked; 45 installed stage/audio files and costume models read back. Original bonus movie preserved.
All 25 fighter banks and the announcer bank match the desktop build; 27 fighter cry sources and both pair cries decoded directly from Colosseum.
All six menu replacements rebuild into the exact accepted main.ssm.
All seven tracks rendered from Colosseum sequences/instruments and rebuilt as looping HPS files; all fingerprints match the desktop build.
Copy the built ISO, encode an xdelta against the exact original Melee disc, decode and hash-verify it, then publish both outputs locally. No game output uploads.

Every component regenerated in an initially empty directory from the two original discs and pinned tools. The run resumed its own verified components after renderer and receipt fixes. Both final ISOs passed installed-file checks and Dolphin smoke tests; both xdeltas decoded to their exact ISO hashes. The source-only wheel imports and generates art independently of the checkout.
